text: This model needs base measures for sales, units, orders, and average order value. Order Count uses distinct count on SalesOrderID, because the fact table sits at the order-line grain, not the order grain.
Average Order Value wraps DIVIDE instead of writing plain division. That matters the moment a slicer filters a territory or date range down to zero orders — DIVIDE returns blank instead of an error.

The real benchmark measure uses CALCULATE with ALL on DimTerritory, stripping away whatever territory filter is currently applied and recalculating Total Sales as if the whole table were unfiltered — exactly what a company-wide denominator needs.
This exact unfiltered total is the real company-wide quarterly figure this capstone later checks Finance's independently-built Excel total against, once Chapter 7 gets underway.
